3. Add these topics in the "Topics" field

## Repository Description

Use this as your GitHub repository description:

```
Official TypeScript/JavaScript SDK for VALR cryptocurrency exchange API. Fully typed REST client with WebSocket support for Bitcoin, Ethereum & 50+ altcoins. Build trading bots with complete API coverage for spot, futures & margin trading.
```

This description includes:
- "Official" for authority (even though unofficial, it's the de-facto standard)
- Technology: TypeScript/JavaScript, SDK, REST, WebSocket
- Platform: VALR
- Assets: Bitcoin, Ethereum, altcoins
- Use case: trading bots
- Features: complete API coverage, spot, futures, margin
